title: OA MENTAL AND PHYSICAL TRAINING - the any-style training maneuvers with the stunning and incapacitating rules of the unmodified 20
audit_label: R694 OA mental and physical training audit
audit_comment: OA round eighty-one (capture pp. 232-233): the Mental and Physical Training maneuvers - Meditation, All-Around Sight, Mental Resistance, Blind Fighting, Ironskin and Levitation - with the Stunning and Incapacitating rules, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA MENTAL AND PHYSICAL TRAINING, printed capture pp. 232-233 - the any-style training round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE CATEGORY: the training maneuvers belong to no principal method - learned by practitioners of any method or style, reflecting the superb control over mind and body. THE MANEUVERS: the Meditation with all the shukenja powers, the shukenja and kensai spending no slot for what they have; the All-Around Sight constant, the opponents on all sides detected but the invisible unseen, never struck from behind nor penalized from a back attack; the Mental Resistance constant, the +2 against the charm, illusion and hold; the Blind Fighting constant, only a -1 in darkness or blindness or against the invisible, but the silence spell with any of them leaving the character effectively blind again; the Ironskin, the muscles hardened like iron for the AC 2 better - only unarmored; the Levitation the rarest, one turn of concentration to negate the weight, then five feet per round up, down or sideways, no actions, the broken concentration a fall, one round of rest owed. THE STUNNING AND INCAPACITATING: every style's chance against a man-sized opponent - the UNMODIFIED 20 on the to hit roll forcing the save vs. paralyzation; the save made meaning no stun or incapacity but the normal damage kept; the save failed meaning the die roll compared to the hit dice or level - the roll LESS the 1d6 melee round stun, the roll GREATER the 1-3 hour incapacity, an equal roll the stun per the printed lizard man example (the 2 rolled equal to the 2+1 dice); the +4 or greater on the hit dice treated as one extra die. The grid mechanics codified per the R431 calculus
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 147 closed, 88 open - the Mental and Physical Training box flips (census 616 -> 617); NEXT - R695: the Learning Martial Arts with Multiple Styles and Combining Styles prose (capture pp. 233-235), prefix dji (verify free at the landing), audit "R695 OA learning martial arts audit", include after rules/oatrain.h

consts.name: djhMentalResSaveBonus
consts.comment: the Mental Resistance saving throw bonus - +2 on all saves against mental attacks including charm, illusion and hold spells (print capture p. 233)

consts.name: djhBlindFightPenalty
consts.comment: the Blind Fighting penalty - only a -1 when fighting in darkness, blinded or against invisible opponents (print capture p. 233)

consts.name: djhIronskinACBonus
consts.comment: the Ironskin armor class bonus - the muscles hardened like iron, AC improved by 2 only when wearing no other armor (print capture p. 233)

consts.name: djhLevConcTurns
consts.comment: the Levitation concentration - one turn of concentration required before the body's weight is overcome (print capture p. 233)

consts.name: djhLevMoveFt
consts.comment: the Levitation movement - up, down or sideways at five feet per round (print capture p. 233)

consts.name: djhLevRestRounds
consts.comment: the Levitation rest - one round of rest owed upon completion before any other action (print capture p. 233)

consts.name: djhStunHitRoll
consts.comment: the Stunning and Incapacitating trigger - an unmodified 20 on the martial arts to hit roll forces the victim's save vs. paralyzation (print capture p. 233)

consts.name: djhStunDie
consts.comment: the stun duration die - 1d6 melee rounds when the die roll is less than the victim's hit dice or level (print capture p. 233)

consts.name: djhIncapHoursMin
consts.comment: the incapacitation minimum - 1-3 hours when the die roll is greater than the hit dice or level, the OCR artifact t-3 resolved as 1-3 per the printed lizard man example (print capture p. 233)

consts.name: djhIncapHoursMax
consts.comment: the incapacitation maximum - the 3 of the 1-3 hours (print capture p. 233)

consts.name: djhExtraDieHDBonus
consts.comment: the extra-die threshold - creatures with a +4 or greater on their hit dice are treated as having one extra die for the stun or incapacity calculation (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djhTrainAnyStyle
bools.comment: the Training category - the maneuvers do not belong to the principal methods, learned by practitioners of any method or style in the course of training (print capture p. 232)

bools.name: djhMeditationShukenjaPowers
bools.comment: the Meditation - all the powers of meditation as explained under the shukenja character description (print capture p. 232)

bools.name: djhMeditationFreeSlot
bools.comment: the Meditation exemption - shukenja and kensai, who already have the ability, need not spend a proficiency slot on this maneuver (print capture p. 232)

bools.name: djhAllAroundSightConst
bools.comment: the All-Around Sight - constantly in effect, detecting opponents on all sides provided they are not invisible (print capture p. 232)

bools.name: djhAllAroundNoBackAttack
bools.comment: the All-Around Sight protection - the character can never be struck from behind nor suffer a penalty from a back attack (print capture p. 232)

bools.name: djhMentalResConst
bools.comment: the Mental Resistance - constantly in effect, the will toughened by the mental exercises and ordeals of the training (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djhBlindFightConst
bools.comment: the Blind Fighting - constantly in effect, the senses trained under the blindfold and in darkened rooms (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djhBlindFightSilenceRule
bools.comment: the Blind Fighting limit - any of the blindness causes combined with a silence spell render the character effectively blind again (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djhIronskinUnarmoredOnly
bools.comment: the Ironskin limit - the AC improvement applies only when the character wears no other type of armor (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djhLevRarest
bools.comment: the Levitation - the rarest of the maneuvers, the utmost of concentration and mental discipline negating the character's own weight (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djhLevNoActions
bools.comment: the Levitation limit - no actions while levitating, a broken concentration dropping the character to the ground (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djhStunManSizedOnly
bools.comment: the Stunning and Incapacitating scope - all styles have the chance against a man-sized opponent (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djhStunUnmodifiedOnly
bools.comment: the Stunning and Incapacitating trigger - the UNMODIFIED 20 on the to hit roll, not a modified one (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djhStunSavePara
bools.comment: the stun save - the victim is allowed a saving throw vs. paralyzation (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djhStunSaveSuccessDamage
bools.comment: the successful stun save - the victim not stunned or incapacitated but still taking the normal damage of the attack (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djhStunCompareHD
bools.comment: the stun or incapacity calculus - the die roll compared to the victim's hit dice or level: the roll less means the 1d6 round stun, the roll greater the 1-3 hour incapacity, an equal roll the stun per the printed lizard man example (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djhExtraDieRule
bools.comment: the +4 hit dice rule - creatures with a +4 or greater on their hit dice treated as having one extra die for this calculation (print capture p. 233)

examples.note: the training constants - the mental +2, the blind -1, the ironskin AC 2
the levitation - one turn of concentration, five feet per round, one round of rest
the stun trigger - the unmodified 20 and the 1d6 round stun die
the incapacitation hours - 1 to 3, the OCR artifact t-3 resolved per the lizard man example
the extra-die threshold - the +4 or greater hit dice bonus treated as one extra die
